create.name: WCCM España (Comunidad Mundial para la Meditación Cristiana - España)
create.bio:
WCCM España is the Spanish community of the World Community for Christian Meditation, registered as a national association with its seat in Pozuelo de Alarcón, near Madrid. It teaches the prayer of silence, stillness and attention handed on by John Main: sitting upright with eyes gently closed and inwardly repeating the prayer word maranatha, coming back to it whenever the mind wanders, for a set time each morning and evening.

It stresses that although meditation is done alone, a group is a real support, so it runs Spanish-language online groups through the week alongside local groups. Its website has a clear guide to how to meditate and a six-part video introduction covering what Christian meditation is, where it comes from, how to build the habit and what it brings. Subscribers receive weekly readings and teachings, reflections by John Main and letters from Laurence Freeman, together with news of courses and activities.
